fact: Car 18 had several blue flags displayed prior to the car behind passing
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 e) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data and in-car video evidence. Although Car 18 received several blue flags before giving way for Car 41, the Stewards determine that Car 41 was neither trying to overtake, nor was it in close enough proximity to mandate Car 18 to move away immediately.
stewards: determine that Car 41 was neither trying to overtake
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 18 Alleged Ignoring Blue Flags
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
